Flood Works — HTML5 canvas game

Game HTML5 3D UI

Flood Works is a browser-based game built on HTML5 canvas, pairing a 3D-rendered world with a lightweight web interface.

Developed with Less Rain, covering concept, art direction, 3D and in-game UI.
